This acute stagnation leaves you well below the recommended ramp rate of +1 to +2 CTL per week, meaning we need to aggressively re-establish consistency without causing injury.

To bridge the gap toward your target CTL of 60 and build both 5km running speed and cycling thresholds, you must establish a reliable weekly routine adhering to the 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 today: a foundational Zone 2 Aerobic Endurance run to safely stimulate your cardiovascular system, re-initiate positive training stress, and respect the 70/30 pyramidal baseline rule before layering on high-intensity intervals.

priority_1.workout_details: 10 min warm-up jog; 35 min steady Zone 2 run focusing on cadence (170-180 spm) and relaxed posture; 5 min cool-down walk/stretch.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely rebuild your running aerobic engine and volume consistency with minimal fatigue accumulation.

priority_2.workout_details: 60 min indoor or outdoor ride in Zone 2 (140-165W). Include 3 x 5-minute blocks at 60-65 rpm in a heavy gear to build cycling torque for power output.
priority_2.reason: Directly targets your 20-minute power milestone and leg strength while keeping the primary aerobic load low-intensity.

priority_3.session_title: Strength for Cycling and Running Power
priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squat 3x6 (RPE 7); Romanian Deadlift 3x8; Weighted Plank 3x45s; Core stability work and upper body chest/shoulder accessory supersets.
priority_3.reason: Builds structural durability and supporting muscular strength for both cycling torque and running stride power without adding cardiovascular fatigue.
